title: MojoBPF published artifact
description: One published build output: the artifact role, the published file name, and the content hash. Names follow the standard artifact layout: <artifact>.bpf.o for one program, <artifact>.<entry>.bpf.o per entry otherwise, plus the <artifact>.evidence.json provenance sidecar.

schema_version.description: Artifact record schema version; this driver writes version 2 only.

role.description: Artifact kind: the built object or the provenance sidecar.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the published bytes, lowercase hex.
